_about: Background apps people don't recognise, with a friendlier name and a better tip. Add one line per app. Names are matched lowercase, with or without .exe.

msmpeng.name: Windows Defender (antivirus)
msmpeng.tip: Defender was scanning your files. Schedule its scans for when you're not working: Task Scheduler > Microsoft > Windows > Windows Defender > Scheduled Scan.

searchindexer.name: Windows Search indexing
searchindexer.tip: Windows was indexing files for search. It calms down once it's done; you can exclude big folders in Settings > Privacy & security > Searching Windows.

tiworker.name: Windows Update installer
tiworker.tip: Windows was installing updates. Set active hours in Settings > Windows Update so this happens when you're away.

onedrive.name: OneDrive sync
onedrive.tip: OneDrive was syncing files. Pause syncing while you work (OneDrive icon > Pause syncing), or exclude large folders.

chrome.name: Google Chrome
chrome.tip: Close the tabs you're not using. Tabs with video, maps or web apps use the most. Chrome's Memory Saver (Settings > Performance) helps too.

msedge.name: Microsoft Edge
msedge.tip: Close the tabs you're not using, and turn on Efficiency mode (Settings > System and performance).

firefox.name: Firefox
firefox.tip: Close the tabs you're not using. about:processes shows which tab is the heaviest.

ms-teams.name: Microsoft Teams
ms-teams.tip: Teams is heavy during calls. Turning off your video or background effects helps a lot.

code.name: VS Code
code.tip: An extension or a big project can make VS Code heavy. Help > Open Process Explorer shows which part.

tracker-miner-fs-3.name: Ubuntu file indexing
tracker-miner-fs-3.tip: Ubuntu was indexing files for search. It settles once done; you can limit indexed folders in Settings > Search.

packagekitd.name: Ubuntu software updates
packagekitd.tip: Ubuntu was checking or installing updates. It's usually short; let it finish.

unattended-upgr.name: Ubuntu automatic updates
unattended-upgr.tip: Ubuntu was installing security updates in the background. Let it finish; it doesn't happen often.

snapd.name: Snap package updates
snapd.tip: Snap was refreshing apps. You can set a refresh time window with: sudo snap set system refresh.timer=...
